title: Change an Employee's Manager
goal: Move one employee to a new line manager with the right effective date, then close the loop with the people affected.
context: Screen steps follow the HCM job aid 'Change Employee Manager in Oracle Cloud' (last updated 3/2/26). The practice app imitates the flow with fictional people; it is not Oracle. DRAFT FOR SME REVIEW: the checkpoint, the offline step, the call step and the reminder describe sensible practice but are not taken from a published SOP. Confirm them, and the contacts, with the HCM Academy team before learners use this lesson for real work.

steps.title: Find the employee
steps.why: Every assignment change starts from the person record, so you are sure you are changing the right employee.
hints: Type at least two letters of the name in the search box.
Type Jordan. Results appear under the search box as you type.

steps.title: Open the actions menu
steps.instruction: Open the Actions menu next to Jordan's name.
hints: The Actions button is at the right end of Jordan's row.

steps.title: Choose the right action
steps.why: The action you pick decides which approvals and downstream updates fire. A new supervisor with no other change is a Change Manager action.
hints: Change Manager is in the Employment group of the menu.

commonMistakes.say: Change Location moves where someone works. Jordan is only getting a new supervisor, so use Change Manager.
Termination ends employment. Jordan is staying. Close that and choose Change Manager.

steps.title: Info to include
steps.instruction: Leave everything on the Info to Include page as it is and select Continue.
steps.why: The job aid is explicit: do not change anything here for a manager change.

success.text: When does the manager change start?

hints: Do not tick or untick anything. Continue is at the bottom of the section.

steps.title: Check the pay type
steps.instruction: Before you pick a date, check whether Jordan is exempt or non-exempt. The pay type is shown under the name at the top of the page.
steps.why: The pay type decides which effective dates are allowed.

steps.title: Set the effective date
steps.instruction: Enter the date the manager change starts. Jordan is non-exempt, so choose a Sunday.

target.label: When does the manager change start?

checks.label: When does the manager change start?

checks.text: first day of the pay period

hints: Open the date picker and choose any Sunday.
The practice app confirms under the field when the date is the first day of a pay period. If it warns you, pick the Sunday before or after.

steps.title: How the manager is changing
steps.instruction: For "What's the way to change the manager?" choose Manager Change.

target.label: What's the way to change the manager?

success.label: What's the way to change the manager?

hints: It is the dropdown directly under the date.
Choose Manager Change from the list.

steps.title: Why the manager is changing
steps.instruction: For "Why are you changing the manager?" choose Change Line Manager.
steps.why: Action reasons drive reporting. The wrong reason makes this look like a different kind of change in the audit trail.

target.label: Why are you changing the manager?

success.label: Why are you changing the manager?

hints: It is the last dropdown in this section.

steps.title: Move to Managers
steps.instruction: Select Continue to move to the Managers section.
hints: Continue is at the bottom of the section you just filled in.

steps.title: Edit the active manager
steps.instruction: Select the pencil icon next to Jordan's active manager.
hints: The pencil is at the right end of the manager row.

steps.title: Assign the new manager
steps.instruction: Delete the current manager's name, search for Priya Raman, and pick her from the list.
steps.why: Picking from the list ties the change to the right person record. Similar names are the most common way this goes wrong.
hints: Clear the Managers field first, then type Priya.
Click Priya Raman in the list that appears under the field.

steps.title: Save
hints: Save is on the manager row you are editing.

steps.title: Submit
steps.why: Save only stores your edit on this page. Nothing changes for the employee until you submit.
hints: Submit is at the top right of the page.

commonMistakes.say: Cancel throws away the whole change. If you saved the new manager and it looks right, use Submit.

steps.title: Tell the new manager
steps.instruction: Let the new manager know the change is in and the date it starts.
steps.why: From the effective date, timecards and absence requests route to the new manager. They should hear it from you, not from a surprise approval.
steps.confirm: I let the new manager know

steps.title: Hand off with the outgoing manager
steps.instruction: Call the outgoing manager to hand off anything still waiting on them.

prep.goal: Agree who handles open approvals for this employee up to the effective date.
prep.opener: Hi, quick one. Jordan's manager change is submitted and starts Sunday. I want to make sure nothing open gets stranded.

pushbacks.if: I was not told about this change
pushbacks.try: Stay factual: say who requested it and the date, and offer to connect them with the requester today.

pushbacks.if: I still have timecards to approve
pushbacks.try: Agree a cut-off: they approve everything dated before the effective date, the new manager takes it from there.

doThis: Say the effective date in your first two sentences.
Ask what is still open for this employee.
End with who does what by when.

callouts.say: For non-exempt employees, the effective date must be the first day of the pay period, which is a Sunday.
callouts.source: Change Employee Manager in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 3/2/26

callouts.say: Manager changes are approved automatically. A confirmation notification arrives shortly after you submit.
callouts.source: Change Employee Manager in Oracle Cloud, job aid updated 3/2/26

fieldValue.label: Why are you changing the manager?

callouts.say: Correction is for fixing a past entry. A new supervisor going forward is Change Line Manager.

reminders.say: Check that the manager change confirmation arrived and the new manager shows on the employee's record.

recap.summary: You changed an employee's line manager with a pay-period-safe effective date, told the new manager, and handed off open items with the outgoing manager.
nextSteps: Next in Assignment Changes: transfers and location changes.
